title: fix(lint): a flow node config-value finding carries the slot's key path, so Studio's Problems row selects the node
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5fJZsb8XwP8keiSa2558sv)_

Fixes #27828

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：流程节点配置值上的 lint 发现（例如「更新记录」里留空的表达式）现在除了原来的文字位置说明，还带上指向该节点配置值的键路径（如 `flows[0].nodes[1].config.fields.status`，草稿诊断里读作 `nodes.1.config.fields.status`）。
- 为什么改：之前这类发现只有一句文字说明，Studio 的「问题」面板能列出它，却点不到、也标不到对应节点；流程一大，作者很难找到挡住发布的那个节点。连线的同类问题 #26858 已经修过，这次补上节点这一半。
- 风险与回滚：只是给发现多加一个 `path` 字段，拒收与否、提示文字都不变；CLI 的 `rule: … at …` 一行会改印键路径（连线自 #26858 起已是如此）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` 节点遍历末尾的路径标记段，`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.node-config-path.test.ts`，`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` 新增的 `[#27828]` 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.node-config-path.test.ts`，预期 7 条全过，其中 “every node-config arm locates its finding at the slot it judged” 覆盖六类节点发现。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Producer** (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, the flow node walk in `runStackExpressionPasses`). Each node site that pushes a finding now also records, in a per-node `where` → key map, the key it judged: `config.condition`, `config.KEY` (the spec's node-config judge), `BLOCK.SLOT_PATH` for a ledger slot and a value-template refusal (so a `connector_action` input from #27968 reads `connectorConfig.input.KEY`), `config.TEXT_SLOT`, and for a `script` node's callable check `config.function` (or the first retired dispatch key the node still carries). At the end of the node's walk, every finding that node produced gets `path: flows[F].nodes[N].KEY`, the #26858 edge spelling.
- **Same limits as the edge path.** `N` indexes the authored `flow.nodes` list (a `null` member before the node does not renumber it). A node inside a nested region (`loop` body) and a map-form `flows` collection have no index to spell, so their findings keep `where` alone. `where` and `message` are unchanged everywhere.
- **No consumer change.** `authoring-rules.ts` already sets `path: i.path ?? i.where` (only its comment gains the node case), and `metadata-protocol` `itemRelativeIssuePath` already re-spells `flows[0].nodes[1].config.fields.status` as `nodes.1.config.fields.status`, which `ui` `flow-problems.ts` `serverTarget` maps onto the node. `ui/` is untouched.
- **`ExprIssue.path` docblock** names the node case.
- **Changeset** `27828-flow-node-config-finding-path.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch, both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.node-config-path.test.ts` (7 tests): the Update Records blank-expression finding carries `flows[0].nodes[1].config.fields.status` with `where` unchanged; a `null` member before the node and a second flow before this one index correctly; one fixture exercises six arms (node `condition`, value-template token, text-slot token, undeclared config key, script with no `function`, `connector_action` input) and asserts each node's path set; map-form `flows` and a node inside a `loop` body keep `path` undefined; the runtime authoring gate's refusal is located at the node config value.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` gains `[#27828] a node config value refused by expression-invalid is located at the node, not in where prose`: a draft with a blank Update Records value is stored, and its draft read's `_diagnostics` reports `valid: false` with every `expression-invalid` entry at `nodes.1.config.fields.name`. Before the fix it read `flow 'blank_value' · node 'set' (update_record) update_record field value at config.fields.name`.
- `validate-expressions.edge-condition-path.test.ts`: the case "a finding off the edge condition gains no path" asserted that a node `condition` finding has no path. That is the behaviour this card changes, so it now asserts the node's own path (`flows[0].nodes[0].config.condition`), still no edge path.
- `validate-expressions.test.ts` receiver meta-test (#5017): the new local `nodeSlotKeys` is excused with its reason (its keys are `Map` methods, never metadata keys).

<details><summary>Red before the fix, and the ablation</summary>

- Before the producer edit (tests committed first on `origin/main` `9f13ee81`): the new lint file ran 5 failed | 2 passed (the two `undefined`-path cases passed), and the metadata-protocol case failed with the prose path quoted above.
- Ablation on committed head `e8b5683d` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the stamp line (`if (key !== undefined) issues[k] = { ...issues[k]!, path: ... }`) replaced by `void key;` (anchor 0 left, replacement 1, counted on disk), lint rebuilt (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`), `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint 'nodes[${nodeIndex}]' --absent` exit 0. Lint: 6 failed | 7 passed across the node and edge path files. metadata-protocol (reads lint's `dist/`): the `[#27828]` case failed, 17 passed. Restored by the EXIT trap; `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash matched `HEAD`; lint rebuilt, preflight `'void key;' --absent` exit 0, metadata-protocol 18/18.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: 180 files; 7655 passed and 1 failed on the first run (the #5017 receiver meta-test, fixed in the next commit), then `validate-expressions.test.ts` 440/440.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: 18/18.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **CLI text face.** `authoringFindingDetailLines` prints `rule: expression-invalid  at PATH`. For these findings that line now names the key path instead of repeating the prose; the verdict line above it still carries `where`. The edge findings have printed this way since #26858.
- **Runtime gate differential.** The gate's baseline/candidate fingerprint includes `path`. Positional node paths compare across its passes the same way edge and validation-rule paths already do; no gate change was needed.
- **Not given a path.** Findings from other node-level rules outside `validateStackExpressions` are unchanged (several, such as `flow-api-trigger-secret-missing`, already carry a key path). A nested-region node's finding could be located at its container (`nodes.CONTAINER.config.body.nodes.I…`); this PR follows the #26858 edge precedent and leaves it on `where`.
- **Optional ui pin** (card Acceptance, separate lane): not in this PR.

## Verification

Head `6360f96e` (merged with `origin/main` `3cc45cc4`, which carries #28150). The gate sweep, the suites and the ablation ran on this tree.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 59 commands. All 59 ran with stdin from /dev/null, exit codes captured before any pipe: 56 exited 0 and 3 first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; pinned commit `621a4876` fetched), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (unbuilt packages). After the prerequisite, all 3 exited 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE`: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Ran list: `spec-seat-1/r2026-10-30/out/27828-gates-ran-6360f96e.list` in the seat's folder.
- Full dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
